verses.1: And he built houses in the city of David. He also prepared a place for the Ark of God to be placed in.
verses.2: Then David said, “Do not carry the Ark of God. Only the Levites are worthy to carry it. For that is what Jehovah has chosen for carrying His Ark and serving Him forever.”
verses.3: And David gathered all of Israel together in Jerusalem, so that they could carry the Ark of God to its proper place.
verses.4: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites.
verses.5: The sons of Kehat were Uriel and his brothers; there were one hundred and twenty of them.
verses.6: The sons of Merari were Shear and his brothers; there were forty in total.
verses.7: Livnei Gershom, Yoel the prophet, and his brothers were a hundred and thirty in number.
verses.8: The sons of Elizaphan, Shmaiah the prophet, and his brothers.
verses.9: The sons of Elisha the prophet and his brothers were named as follows:
verses.10: The sons of Euziel, Aminadav, the prophet, and his brothers numbered one hundred and twenty.
verses.11: David called for Zadok, Abiathar, the priests, and the Levites to go to Oria. They were to bring with them Asiya, Shemaiah, Eliezer, and Amnon.
verses.12: And he said to them, “You are the heads of the tribes of Israel. You and your ancestors have brought the Ark of God, the Lord of Israel, to me for my preparation.”
verses.13: For in the beginning, you did not obey Jehovah our God. We were not obedient to Him as He commanded us.
verses.14: And the priests and Levites were sanctified to carry the Ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.15: And the sons of Levi carried the Ark of God, as Moses had commanded them, according to the word of Jehovah, on their shoulders.
verses.16: And David said to the Levites, “Have them set up instruments that can play songs of joy. Let them be instruments that can bring joy to the mountains.”
verses.17: And the Levites appointed Jehiel as their leader. From among his brothers, they chose Beseriah. And from among the sons of Merari, they chose Eitan.
verses.18: And with them were their brothers, Zekarya, Ben, Ya’el, Shmira’mot, Viyiel, Uni Eliaw, and their sons. Also there were Ma’asiyah, Matityah, Eliphal, Miknei, and the servants of Adam. And Yeyiel HaSho’rim.
verses.19: And those who were in charge gathered together, and Eitan stood in their midst, ready to speak.
verses.20: And Zekarya, Azariah, Shmiramoth, Yihiel, Uniy, Eliahu, and Maaseya. And their sons were also destroyed in the flames of destruction.
verses.21: And they will kill him, and throw him into the pit. They will also work for Adam, and they will be punished. They will be burned alive in pits on the eighth floor, so that they can be destroyed.
verses.22: And He appointed him as the ruler of the nations. He was chosen for this role because he understood what it meant to rule.
verses.23: And in Bercheya and Elkanah, there are villages for the people of Arun.
verses.24: And Shabna, Yosafat, Netanel, Amashai, Zekhariah, and Benyahu. And Elyazar, the priests, from their palaces in front of the Temple of God. They served Adam, and they lived in those houses for a time.
verses.25: And David, along with the elders of Israel and the leaders of the tribes who went to carry up the Ark of God’s covenant from the house of Adam, were happy.
verses.26: And God helped those who carried the offerings of the covenant of Jehovah. They offered seven sheep and seven goats as sacrifices.
verses.27: And David was crowned king, and all the people who gathered around him, those who carried the ark and those who served as priests. And upon David, there was joy.
verses.28: And all of Israel shall raise up their voices in triumph, with loud cries and shouts. Their voices will be heard from far away, through the windows and doors of their homes.
verses.29: And the LORD’s covenant came to the city of David. From the palace of Bathsheba, she saw King David dancing and laughing. She was deeply moved by him.
